## [{{< iconify thesvg-color:microsoft-excel >}} [Embedded Spreadsheets ]{.spreadsheet} {{< iconify thesvg-color:google-sheets >}}](https://github.com/wearetechnative/embed-sheet)

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Do dis... {{< iconify flat-color-icons:ok >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

+ `![]()` for all file types, or 
+ `<iframe>` for html files:

``` bash
<iframe
  width="100%"
  height="400"
  src="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kLD8C7x5ko_tbypM6Xd4PJEsrPxrJpIlZhC8V7FADkc/edit?usp=sharing"
  title="Spreadsheet">
</iframe>
```

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

<iframe
  width="100%"
  height="400"
  src="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1kLD8C7x5ko_tbypM6Xd4PJEsrPxrJpIlZhC8V7FADkc/edit?usp=sharing"
  title="Spreadsheet">
</iframe>

:::

:::

### ...not dat {{< iconify emojione:no-entry >}}

::: {.columns .Smaller}

::: {.column width="39%"}

1. Add to PATH (via Windows)

2. make LibreOffice visible (adding to PATH only makes `soffice.exe` visible, extension needs `libreoffice.exe` to be visible) 

:::

::: {.column width="35%"}

3. Create `bin` folder at same level as project folder with `libreoffice.bat` file

4. More windows PATH adjustments

5. Restart IDE

:::

::: {.column width="26%"}

#### Moral of the story: 

extension is maximized with {{< iconify devicon:unix >}}--styled operating systems (e.g., {{< iconify devicon:linux >}} or {{< iconify catppuccin:macos >}}), it's a pain--in--the--rear with {{< iconify selfhst:windows-retro >}}

:::
:::

:::
